source.name: measured vapour pressures and the critical point
source.fit: 29 measured values (29 from the ThermoML Archive), 303.15-448.15 K, max deviation 29 %. No measured critical constants: the record covers the measured temperatures only. All the measured sets fitted together, each article with the same weight (no set preferred for a smaller stated uncertainty), pooled because they agree: each set lies within its mean stated uncertainty of the curve on average; mean deviation of the fit from each set: Lomba 2014 +3.32 %. The largest deviations are at values whose stated uncertainty exceeds 10 % (7 values, 12-1.1e+02 %); among the values stated within 10 %, the largest deviation is 5.0 %.
